name: Chase Sapphire Reserve® for Business

welcome_offer.description: Limited-time offer: Earn 200,000 bonus points after spending $30,000 on purchases in the first 6 months from account opening.
notes: Chase official reservebusiness0626 offer page is canonical for the 200,000-point limited-time offer; secondary June 2026 coverage corroborates.

earning_rates.notes: 8x points on all purchases through Chase Travel, including The Edit
5x total points on Lyft rides through 9/30/27
4x points on flights & hotels booked direct
3x points on social media & search engine advertising, on up to $1 million in spend each anniversary year (starting 11/15/26)

lounge_access.name: Priority Pass Select
lounge_access.description: Unlimited Priority Pass Select lounge access for cardmember and guests; Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club are a separate access benefit.

lounge_access.name: Sapphire Lounge by The Club
lounge_access.description: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounges with up to two guests.

other_benefits.name: Priority Pass Select
other_benefits.description: Unlimited Priority Pass Select lounge access for cardmember and guests

other_benefits.name: Global Entry/TSA PreCheck
other_benefits.description: Up to $120 reimbursement for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS every 4 years

other_benefits.name: Transfer Partners
other_benefits.description: 1:1 point transfer to 14+ airline/hotel partners including United, Southwest, Hyatt, Marriott, British Airways

other_benefits.name: Primary Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
Emergency Evacuation Coverage
other_benefits.description: Up to $100,000 for emergency medical evacuation

other_benefits.name: Trip Cancellation/Interruption
other_benefits.description: Up to $20,000 per person and $40,000 per trip

other_benefits.name: 24/7 Concierge
other_benefits.description: Access to travel and lifestyle concierge services

other_benefits.name: Employee Cards at No Cost
other_benefits.description: Add employee cards at no additional annual fee

other_benefits.name: FHR Benefits
other_benefits.description: Access to Chase's Luxury Hotel & Resort Collection (FHR) with breakfast, early check-in, upgrades, $100 experience credit

other_benefits.name: The Hotel Collection
other_benefits.description: THC: Complimentary room upgrade and $100 food/beverage credit at THC properties

fhr_thc.notes: Full FHR and THC access for business travelers. Can be combined with personal Sapphire Reserve for doubled lounge access and credits.

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: 200k after $30k/6 mo; 8x Chase Travel/5x Lyft/4x direct flights & hotels/3x social & search ads/1x; $300 travel, $500 The Edit, $400 ZipRecruiter, $200 Google Workspace, $120 Lyft, $100 gift cards, $120 Global Entry, DoorDash DashPass + $25/mo promos. No Instacart credit.

notes: Business version of Sapphire Reserve. Same $795 AF and credits. 200,000 point limited-time welcome bonus makes it very attractive. Employee cards are free. Can combine points with personal Sapphire Reserve for larger balances. Key for business travelers who want same premium benefits as personal Reserve.

recurring_credits.name: Annual Travel Credit
recurring_credits.description: $300 annual credit on travel purchases (auto-applied, no enrollment)

recurring_credits.name: The Edit Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $500 annually for prepaid hotel bookings through The Edit by Chase Travel ($250 max per transaction).

recurring_credits.name: Google Workspace Credit
recurring_credits.description: $200 annual credit for Google Workspace purchases.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 every 4 years for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Promos
recurring_credits.description: With complimentary DashPass (activate by 12/31/27): up to $25 each month on DoorDash: a $5 monthly restaurant promo plus two $10 promos for groceries, retail and more. Available through 12/31/27.

recurring_credits.name: ZipRecruiter Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $400 per year in ZipRecruiter statement credits ($200 Jan–Jun and $200 Jul–Dec).

recurring_credits.name: Curated Gift Card Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $100 per year in statement credits for gift cards purchased from a curated collection ($50 per half-year).
